notes: Customer snapshot: mid-market commerce platform (checkout disputes + returns ops ~2.2k agents worldwide during peak campaigns).
Primary ask: build agent-assist that can (a) summarize customer threads, (b) call company APIs to create/update tickets, and (c) initiate refunds/escalations with audit trails.
Tool-calling specifics: must integrate with Zendesk (create/update tickets), internal refunds service (POST /refunds v2), and PagerDuty for high-severity escalations.
Idempotency & safety: require idempotency keys for refund calls, 2-phase confirmation for refunds > $200, and server-side request signing.
Latency & throughput: p50 target <120ms for model suggestions (agent assistant), p95 <350ms under normal load; peak windows: sustained 3k concurrent agents for 4-6 hours during promos.
Reliability ask: automatic fallback to quantized / smaller model variant on capacity pressure, graceful degradation path (suggestions-only mode without auto-tool-calls).
Security/compliance: strict data residency for EU customers, SAML SSO, audit logs retained 2 years, KMS-backed secrets, SOC2 baseline plus encryption at rest in private deployments.
Obs + ops: need token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency dashboards; want alerts on regression from eval prompt set for refunds accuracy.
Quote from CTO: "If this can't handle our promo spikes with zero false refunds, it's a non-starter. Need deterministic retries and clear audit trails."

POC scope (agreed): ingest 30k anonymized threads, integrate Zendesk create/update, wire refunds sandbox, run synthetic spike test to 3k concurrent agent sessions, collect per-token cost and latency metrics.
Sticking points: security wants HSM/KMS diagram, legal needs data processing addendum, infra needs clarifications on VPC peering and egress rules.
